sql: WITH base AS (SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING("CLM_FROM_DT" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INT) AS yr, "CLM_PMT_AMT", "CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT", "CLM_DRG_CD", COALESCE("NCH_BENE_IP_DDCTBL_AMT", 0) AS ded, COALESCE("NCH_BENE_PTA_COINSRNC_LBLTY_AM", 0) AS coin FROM ds_cms_claims WHERE "CLM_FROM_DT" ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' AND SUBSTRING("CLM_FROM_DT" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2008', '2010')), summary AS (SELECT yr, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS claims_cnt, CAST(AVG("CLM_PMT_AMT") AS DECIMAL) AS avg_pmt, CAST(AVG("CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT") AS DECIMAL) AS avg_los, CAST(AVG(ded) AS DECIMAL) AS avg_ded, CAST(AVG(coin) AS DECIMAL) AS avg_coin FROM base GROUP BY yr), drg_agg AS (SELECT yr, "CLM_DRG_CD", CAST(SUM("CLM_PMT_AMT") AS DECIMAL) AS total_pmt FROM base WHERE "CLM_DRG_CD" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr, "CLM_DRG_CD"), drg_pivot AS (SELECT "CLM_DRG_CD", MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN total_pmt END) AS pmt_2008, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN total_pmt END) AS pmt_2010 FROM drg_agg GROUP BY "CLM_DRG_CD"), top_drg AS (SELECT "CLM_DRG_CD", pmt_2008, pmt_2010, (pmt_2010 - pmt_2008) AS diff FROM drg_pivot WHERE pmt_2008 IS NOT NULL AND pmt_2010 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT 'summary' AS section, CAST(yr AS TEXT) AS year, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS drg, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pmt_2008, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pmt_2010, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS diff, claims_cnt, avg_pmt, avg_los, avg_ded, avg_coin FROM summary UNION ALL SELECT 'top_drg' AS section, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS year, "CLM_DRG_CD" AS drg, pmt_2008, pmt_2010, diff, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS claims_cnt, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS avg_pmt, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS avg_los, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS avg_ded, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS avg_coin FROM top_drg ORDER BY 1, 2, 4
